title: Chart build
description: A bar, line or donut chart that builds itself: bars grow from the baseline, the line draws across, the donut sweeps round, every label counting up. A big number counts to the highlighted value; after a beat of stillness the highlighted bar/point/segment turns the accent, the rest dim, and a change badge lands. For stats, results and growth claims in promos and explainers. Over video (placement over_video) the chart sits on a glass plate so it reads over the footage; plate solid or none to change that.

kind.description: bar (categories side by side), line (a trend over time) or donut (parts of a whole).

title.default: Hours saved per person, each month
title.description: What the chart measures, in sentence case (empty: none).

values.description: The numbers, one per bar/point/segment ("1,240", "46%" and "$3.5" are read as numbers; donut takes at most 6).

labels.description: Category or time label of each value.

highlight.description: Which value the big number counts to and the accent marks (0-based; -1: the largest, or a line's last point).

suffix.description: After every number, e.g. %, k or h.

caption.description: Badge text at the highlight (empty: the change from the first value, e.g. "+283% vs Jan", for bar and line; none for donut).

rest.description: Colour of the bars/line/segments that are not highlighted (default the ink).

plate.description: A card behind the chart: auto (glass over video, none full frame), glass (translucent, the footage shows through), solid (the palette's paper) or none.
